body:
## Scope
Reuse the completed REI PR213 warm non-tilted LRS C15 729-case pilot. No new ODE, NCP job, or benchmark. Matter and radiation retain independent signed tensor components; total is summed before taking its norm.

## Actual new work
The endpoint reconstruction Fhat(S,m,r)=F(S,m,0)+F(S,0,r)-F(S,0,0) consumes only 153 axis cases and is compared against 576 withheld mixed endpoints. This is a retrospective stored-data comparison, not preregistered prospective validation or a new solver. No fit coefficients.

Maximum signed endpoint discrepancies: S 1.5612511283791264e-17; matter P 2.2970232486929643e-14; radiation P 1.6540805183873353e-14; total P 3.9510982640131203e-14. Original ODE error and long-window accuracy are not certified. Inherited 3e-13 is only a display/orientation floor.

12 focused unit tests actually pass, including no held-out leakage, a nonadditive counterexample, cancellation, malformed grids and separate normalization. Wolfram checks tensor contractions and the mixed-residual rectangle identity. Review is serial; independent agents were unavailable.

## Identities
REC base df95a074730ea0d13d609cf88d448f01f4a47ef1. Source/result publication d2c0fbb5fa06dfc37db57876bb130ef8a4fa8a5d. Executed reducer SHA256 453eee672e2a6d78bf0f76aa42f5453e68c1066cc561f5fe547be9e30e01e457. Input CSV c322453eed4c4c236ff19501ea6eca50353d6ebecc604a6cab9647b3a090255c from REI result c8e9f67aa031ffb33a9b0347bdea61dbb01fb746; C15 owner80825585f9fe31d2ee0d5af545ada3fa1f52be72 unchanged.

## Limits and next delivery
Proposed 153 support+90 sentinel design is not submitted and does not authorize replacing exact solver results. No measured speedup/scaling/memory-reduction claim. Full EoR, general non-LRS, source Q closure and production remain HOLD. Completed REC U4B and other pilots are reused; no owner/default changes. Figures, full archive, DAG and handoffs will follow as additive delivery. Draft only, no merge.
